standard_prerequisites.name: Purity along a fibre and its behaviour under an elementary etale neighbourhood and under flat base change
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter flat.tex, definition labelled definition-pure and the discussion following it (proof lines 5294-5295), and label lemma-flat-descend-pure (proof line 5303)
standard_prerequisites.use: Keeps purity after pulling back along an elementary etale neighbourhood, and lets purity of the base change along a flat pointed morphism descend to purity of the original, which is what makes the reduction in the preliminary paragraph legitimate.

standard_prerequisites.name: Existence of an affine etale neighbourhood on which the module has free global sections, and purity of such a module
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter flat.tex, labels lemma-finite-type-flat-along-fibre-free-variant (proof line 5322) and lemma-affine-locally-projective-pure (proof line 5339)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the etale g : X' -> X with X' affine, X_s contained in g(X') and the global sections of the pullback free over the localised base, and gives that the pulled back module is universally pure over S.

standard_prerequisites.name: The purity criterion through relative associated primes and their base change behaviour
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter flat.tex, label lemma-criterion (proof lines 5343 and 5357); Divisors, label divisors-lemma-base-change-relative-assassin (proof line 5347) and remark divisors-remark-base-change-relative-assassin (proof line 5348)
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns purity along the fibre into the inclusion of the relative associated primes of F over S inside the image of the etale morphism, and shows that this inclusion is stable under arbitrary base change of the pointed base, which yields universal purity.

core_obligations: Reduce to an elementary etale neighbourhood: for an elementary etale (S', s') -> (S, s) the pullback of F is again pure along the new fibre and flat over the new base along it, and by the flat descent of purity it suffices to prove universal purity after such a replacement; one may also replace S by its localisation at s (proof lines 5290-5307).

Choose a free affine etale neighbourhood: take the elementary etale neighbourhood and the etale g : X' -> X with X' affine, X_s contained in g(X') and the global sections of g^*F free over the localised base, replace S by that localisation so that S is local and the global sections of g^*F are free over the local ring of S, and note that g^*F is then universally pure over S (proof lines 5309-5339).

Conclude by the criterion: apply the purity criterion to deduce that the relative associated primes of F over S lie inside g(X'), then use the base change formula for relative associated primes to see that for every pointed morphism (T, t) -> (S, s) the relative associated primes of the pullback over T lie inside g_T(X'_T), and apply the criterion again to the base changed diagram to obtain purity of F_T along X_t, which is universal purity (proof lines 5341-5359).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the case of a free affine etale neighbourhood of the fibre and a local base (proof lines 5290-5339).
Use the purity criterion to place the relative associated primes inside the image of the etale morphism (proof lines 5341-5345).
Transport that inclusion along an arbitrary base change and apply the criterion once more to get universal purity (proof lines 5346-5359).
difficulty_reason: The lemma upgrades purity along a fibre to universal purity, for a finite type morphism and a finite type module that is flat over the base at every point of the fibre (statement lines 5275-5288, tag 05L5). The proof is a real reduction: it first shows that purity may be checked after an elementary etale neighbourhood of the base via flat descent of purity, then builds a free affine etale neighbourhood of the fibre so that the module has free global sections, and finally converts purity into an inclusion of relative associated primes inside the image of the etale morphism and observes that this inclusion is preserved by arbitrary base change, which is exactly universal purity. The transport of the associated prime inclusion is the substance, so the claim is H2.
